task.description:
Write the regression test for ISS-0721 per lib/letflow/design/iss0721-entity-event-type-seeding.md section 6's spec: provision a tenant (using the standard test provisioning helper -- check existing tests under test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/ for the established pattern), run replay_migrations/2 with a default manifest (using_default_manifest? true path), do NOT call Letflow.Entities.EventTypes.seed!/1 manually, then attempt a real entity-record write (or directly assert against Letflow.EventStore.Registry.get_type/2 that ENTITY_RECORD_CREATED/UPDATED/DELETED are now registered for the tenant's schema) and assert it succeeds. Also add a second-call idempotency assertion: call replay_migrations/2 (or the relevant seeding path) twice and assert no error on the second call.

This is a fix to EXISTING but never-wired behavior (seed!/1 itself is not new), so WF-03's fail-then-pass rule applies in its straightforward form (not the mutation-testing fallback for a genuinely new module): prove the new test FAILS against the pre-fix code and PASSES post-fix. Do this via a throwaway git worktree of origin/main (pre-fix tip, before this run's commits) -- `git worktree add ../letflow-iss0721-prefix origin/main`, copy only the new test file into that worktree, run it there, confirm it fails with the expected :unknown_event_type-shaped error, then remove the worktree (`git worktree remove ../letflow-iss0721-prefix`). Then run the same test on this branch (feature/WF03-ISS0721-20260919, post-fix) and confirm it passes. Record both raw outputs in result.summary. Do NOT modify lib/ -- test file only.
acceptance_criteria: New test file under test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/ covering: fresh-tenant entity-record write succeeds without manual seed!/1 call; second-call idempotency
Fail-first proof: test run against pre-fix code (origin/main via throwaway worktree) fails with the actual pre-fix error, raw output quoted
Pass proof: same test run against post-fix code (this branch) passes, raw output quoted
Worktree cleaned up and verified removed

=== FAIL-FIRST PROOF (pre-fix, origin/main @ ffc433d2, throwaway worktree ../letflow-iss0721-prefix) ===
`git worktree add ../letflow-iss0721-prefix origin/main`, only the new test file copied in, `mix deps.get`, then:

  1) test ISS-0721 -- entity event types are auto-seeded by replay_migrations/2 the three ENTITY_RECORD_* event types are registered as a side effect of provisioning alone (Letflow.TenantProvisioning.EntityEventTypeSeedingTest)
     match (=) failed
     code:  assert {:ok, _type} = Registry.get_type(event_type, tenant_id)
     left:  {:ok, _type}
     right: {:error, :unknown_event_type}
  2) test ISS-0721 -- entity event types are auto-seeded by replay_migrations/2 a second replay_migrations/2 call against the same tenant does not error, and writes still succeed (Letflow.TenantProvisioning.EntityEventTypeSeedingTest)
     match (=) failed

Result: 0/2 passed
Failed: 2 tests
Both failures reproduce ISS-0721's exact named failure mode ({:error, :unknown_event_type}) -- not vacuous. Worktree then removed: `git worktree remove ../letflow-iss0721-prefix --force`, confirmed via `git worktree list` showing only the main working tree.

$ mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/entity_event_type_seeding_test.exs

Finished in 4.2 seconds (0.00s async, 4.2s sync)

Both tests pass post-fix.

=== mix letflow.check.test (full suite, run for real, output quoted) ===
Ran mix letflow.check.test to completion twice, cleanly (single invocation each time, ~432-436s main-suite runtime, no concurrent contention -- a stray extra concurrent invocation on my part caused a THIRD, unrelated, self-inflicted Postgres 'too_many_connections' run in between, which I discarded and is not reported as evidence). Both clean runs FAIL, but on the SAME pre-existing, change-unrelated flake both times -- Letflow.Engine.Lua.PlatformTest (REQ-161, lib/letflow/engine/lua/platform.ex's platform.fail/exit semantics), never on anything in tenant_provisioning.ex or the new test file:
Run A: 'Result: 358/360 passed / Failed: 2 tests' -- both failures in PlatformTest's 'REQ-161: platform.fail terminates by exit/1...' describe block (AC1 and AC2 sub-tests), each showing a Task crash log for {:script_failed, ...} (the test's own intentional/expected crash-log noise, per that test's own moduledoc) immediately preceding a genuine assertion mismatch.
Run B (fully independent invocation, no shared state): 'Result: 358/360 passed / Failed: 2 tests' again -- same describe block, same 358/360 total, but a DIFFERENT specific sub-assertion failed than Run A ('AC2: a missing reason/details pair defaults to the documented fallback string and nil' this time vs 'AC2: the structured failure carries the reason/details...' in Run A) -- consistent with a timing-sensitive flake under full-parallel-suite load, not a deterministic break.
Both runs: `** (Mix) mix letflow.check.test: FAILED -- scripts/test_parallel.sh exited 1 (real test failure/error).` -- because run_main_suite raises on any real test failure BEFORE reaching the ISS-0069 substring check (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex:248-258), so the ISS-0069 gate itself was never reached by either run; it is not that it failed, it was not exercised.
Evidence this flake is pre-existing and unrelated to this diff (not investigated further -- out of this handoff's scope, ISS-0721 touches only tenant_provisioning.ex and its own test tree):
(a) `mix test test/letflow/engine/lua/platform_test.exs` run in isolation: 'Result: 100 passed' -- zero failures when not competing for resources under the full 16-partition parallel suite.
(b) This diff's only lib/ change (already-committed, pre-existing on this branch before my step) is tenant_provisioning.ex; this handoff's own new files are test-tree only. Neither touches lib/letflow/engine/lua/ in any way.
(c) `git status --short` confirms no lib/ files touched by this step.
Substitute ISS-0069 verification (since the real task's own substring check was never reached by either full run): `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --force --warnings-as-errors` (fresh full recompile, lib+test) -- clean, zero warnings. `MIX_ENV=test mix test --warnings-as-errors test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/entity_event_type_seeding_test.exs` (forced fresh recompile of just this file) -- 'Result: 2 passed', zero warnings, confirming this new test file's own helpers carry no ISS-0069-class dead-default-argument warning.
Flagged in result.issues below for ORCH/RELEASE-VALIDATOR: the pre-existing PlatformTest flake blocks a clean mix letflow.check.test run on this branch and should be triaged separately from ISS-0721.

issues.description: mix letflow.check.test does not exit clean on this branch, but not due to ISS-0721 or this step's new test: Letflow.Engine.Lua.PlatformTest (REQ-161, lib/letflow/engine/lua/platform.ex) fails 2/360 tests under the full 16-partition parallel suite, non-deterministically (a different specific sub-assertion failed across two independent clean runs), while passing 100/100 in isolation (`mix test test/letflow/engine/lua/platform_test.exs`).
